csv_project_name: AE for Daniel K. Inouye Apron Lighting Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The Hawaii Department of Transportation (HDOT), Airports seeks the services of qualified engineering firms to provide design services for Apron Lighting Improvements, Daniel K. Inouye International Airport, State Project No. AO1022-19. The project scope includes replacing approximately 90 aging high mast ramp lights/apron lighting throughout Daniel K. Inouye International Airport with energy efficient light-emitting diode (LED) fixtures. The replacements will occur throughout the airport, including the gates at Terminal 1 (Concourses A and B) and Terminal 2 (Concourses C, E, G, Gates D and F), Diamond Head hardstands to Delta Cargo area, Aloha Air Cargo/ARFF Hardstand area, along Elliot Street, as well as the South Ramp hardstands.
csv_disciplines_requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
